output.answer_markdown: The material does not give a computed capital-intensity measure for FY2022, such as capex to revenue or PP&E to assets, so I cannot say definitively whether 3M is capital-intensive. The filings do show that 3M is a manufacturer that invests in property, plant and equipment [1]. They say those investments support growth and manufacturing efficiency [2]. In 2022 3M spent approximately $317 million on capital projects for environmental purposes alone [3]. It expects 2023 capital spending of approximately $1.5 billion to $1.8 billion [4].
